title: Reading Real-Life Graphs
summary: Distance–time, filling and cooling graphs: what rises, flat parts, jumps and curves mean.

ib.note: Interpreting graphs is MYP 3 (links to MYP Sciences)

cbse.chapter: Earlier NCERT Ch 13: Introduction to Graphs

objectives: I can describe what a real-life graph shows.
I can explain flat parts, steep parts and curves.
I can sketch a graph for a story.
misconceptions: A graph is a picture of the journey's path.
A flat line means nothing is happening to time.
